runner: harness.html in browser (srcdoc + injected error hook)
notes: Run in the app's browser pane against a local python http.server; Node/Playwright are not installed on this Mac, so verify_r012.cjs was not run.

First rev 4 run: 31/32. The browser-error check FAILED because the probe error was thrown in the parent page's realm, so the injected hook never saw it. Fixed in the harness (probe now runs inside the walkthrough frame and must capture both a thrown error and a console.error); re-run 32/32. The model was not changed between the two runs.

Thresholds stated plainly: shower depth uses ≥ 890 mm because 899 mm is modelled against a 900 mm nominal; the narrowest dry route is 676 mm at the towel bar, which passes a 650 mm single-person passage but NOT a 900 mm walker width (trade-off recorded in the packet).
Architect floor-drain point (x 1.27, z 26.37 ft) is read from a 5,000 px raster of architect-layout.pdf at about 67.9 px/ft (about ±30 mm); site must confirm the actual sleeve.

Rev 4.1 (after independent QA site-qa-03): fixed the unnamed 'Master shower' feature record (my rev 4 edit had replaced the literal with an undefined variable), towel-rail clearance from glass 18 → 42 mm, stale 150 mm text in R-012.json; added checks for the shower feature record, rail-to-glass clearance and WC clearance to the glass FACE (408 mm). Re-run at 13:24:49Z, about 10 minutes after the last harness edit (13:14Z), so it used the fixed harness. Checks for PRV, hot-water, downlight and blocking still test recorded notes, not geometry; the outlet check compares to the architect point the author entered (independently re-measured by site-qa-03 at z 26.42).
